title: Little Flight Day
hook: Keep the comparison card outside the real sequence.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D civilian aviation storybook, toy aircraft and ground gear, clean sky scenes; visual identity: Little Flight Day

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child narrating one flight-day sequence
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: object fact tied honestly to normal flight or comparison
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: timeline-neutral recall -> exact target -> safe gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Little Flight Day a timeline from preflight information and ground service through taxi/takeoff, cruise, arrival, and shutdown, while model/zero-g comparison targets are placed outside an ordinary passenger flight.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child follows one normal flight day and moves X-wing Model and Zero-gravity Plane to comparison cards rather than pretending they are ordinary airline stages.
